verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page offers the open-source library "at no cost," so self-hosted use has no license fee and no per-request charge as records or queries grow. The pack shows nothing about Orama Cloud's pricing structure, usage tiers, overage rules or caps, and the only other pricing-page item describes an enterprise assessment, not usage pricing. missing for 10: documented Cloud pricing tiers and how they scale with records and query volume, explicit statements on overages or per-request charges, spend caps or predictability guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cost behavior at scale.

support.subject: As a founder, costs stay predictable as records and query volume grow — no surprise per-request cliffs

citations.quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
